title: Apollo 14 · Fra Mauro

frame.note: Origin is the LM descent-stage point in this mission’s published mapping archive. Coordinates are source projected metres minus that origin (east/north), rounded to 1 cm for storage, not claims of centimetre accuracy. This frame has not replaced existing game coordinates.

registration.note: Clockwise bearing of the source north arrow from screen-up. Registration pertains only to this historical image; do not overlay the modern vector routes on it as if geodetically controlled.

map.accuracy: USGS Professional Paper 880 Plate 2 postflight map, scan by Brian McInall. Manual scale-bar registration for historical comparison, not alignment with modern LROC geometry. Registration error is not quantified.

boundary.rationale: Mapped EVA 1/2 union buffered by at least 100 m, expanded north to include the complete Cone Crater landform visible in the postflight map and south for context. Cone landform extent is an approximate context allowance, not a surveyed rim polygon. Astronauts did not traverse its interior.

routes.note: Render segments separately. points is the first segment only for schema compatibility; concatenating segments would invent travel. terrain.name: LROC NAC_DTM_APOLLO14
terrain.projection: Equirectangular, planetocentric; -3° standard parallel, 180° central meridian, positive-east longitude; spherical radius 1,737,400 m. Verified in retained PDS label and mapping PRJ.
terrain.elevationDatum: LOLA-tied heights above the 1,737,400 m reference sphere; LROC processing guide converts this DTM family to radius by adding 1,737,400 m. No height raster ingested in this research pass.

coverage.note: Published DTM product polygon contains the mapped mission geometry and proposed boundary corners only if the checks below pass. This is not a valid-elevation/confidence mask; inspect NoData, seams and confidence raster before terrain construction.

sources.title: LROC NAC processing guide, reference-radius conversion
LROC NAC DTM product footprint index

gaps: Terrain confidence/NoData raster not yet inspected; product footprint containment alone does not certify continuous usable elevation.
Published mapped paths reconstruct observed/documented activity; missing undocumented motion cannot be recovered. This is coverage of all published EVA layers, not proof of every historical footstep.
Map registration is contextual only. Future terrain construction must use the modern PDS frame and controlled orthophoto, not stretch these vectors to fit the old map.
Camera XY has been imported where available, but camera height, direction, lens/FOV, shadows and scene geometry remain to be fitted against each actual photograph.
Human-sized apparatus and optional ring offsets must remain separate from geographic anchors. Existing compressed runtime coordinates and saves have not changed.
The current cart stop places a base-area photograph on the uphill route. Its ring and subject need a photo-grounded location.
S71-19509 is a film still, so no exact Hasselblad position was found. No invented camera coordinate supplied.
Cone Crater context allowance is not a digitized crater rim. Validate its full perimeter and horizon against the DTM/orthophoto before freezing the playground.

documentedDistanceComparison.status: Different accounting; do not force agreement by scaling or deleting task paths.
documentedDistanceComparison.note: SP-4029 reports about 1 km in EVA 1, about 3 km in EVA 2 and more than 4 km total traversed. Modern individual task-path sums are larger. The footprint is derived from coordinates, not by equating these different distance measures.

sourceMappingAccuracy.note: 2021 methodology gives about 1 m spatial precision where video exists; without video, maximum error radii of 5 m for EVA 1 and 8 m for EVA 2. These study estimates are not an independently checked per-point guarantee for the later archive.
